chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Mismā‘ ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام.
That Ali عليه السلام ruled regarding the eye of a beast that its compensation is one quarter of the price.

key_terms.عَيْنِ: the eye, referring here to the animal’s eye
key_terms.قَضَى: issued a legal ruling or judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for injuring the eye of an animal according to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from Imam Ali عليه السلام concerning injury to an animal. It states that for the loss of one eye of a beast, the compensation is one quarter of its market value.
